query: SELECT uses_knowledge_graph, baseline, agent_framework FROM cspaper WHERE baseline != 'RAG; DPR + FiD; KGI; Re2G; Hindsight; SEAL + FiD; Re3val; GripRank; PLATO; FiD-Light (T5-Base, k = 64); FiD-Light (T5-XL, k = 8)' AND baseline_amount < 10 AND generator_model = 'Mistral-7B-Instruct; Llama2-7B-Chat; GPT-3.5-turbo' AND topic = 'Information Retrieval';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。
